purpose: Teach: 終る/顧み/ためらい/程遠い/まるっきり/ひとたび/きまり/だいじょうぶ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんは一日の仕事が終ると、お酒を一杯飲まれたぞ
lines.en: Gran — when your father was young, he'd have a drink the moment work ended each day.
lines.style: Soft, nostalgic opening. Gentle pace, like remembering something precious and fragile. Voice settles into a minor key. No rush to finish.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、戦時代を顧みる時、お顔が曇られたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes — and didn't his face cloud over when he'd think back on those war years, dear?
lines.style: Warm acknowledgment, reaching toward him. Gentle observation without judgment. Rising slightly on the question, inviting him to continue. Softness in the word "dear."

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんはためらいなく決断されたぞ
lines.en: Gran — your father made decisions without hesitation when he was young.
lines.style: Quieter this time. Voice tightens slightly with admiration. Measured delivery, each phrase distinct. Trailing off into something like wonder.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、目標達成には程遠い時期もありましたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: But there were times too, weren't there, when he was far from his goals, dear?
lines.style: Gentle counterpoint, not contradiction. Soft knowing in her tone. She's seen the whole arc. Ending on "dear" with warmth that steadies him.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、お父さんはまるっきりお酒に手を付けない時期もあったぞ
lines.en: Gran — there were stretches when your father didn't touch a drop at all.
lines.style: Slower now. Voice becomes more deliberate. Each word matters. Pause weight before "at all" — it's a significant absence, not nothing.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、ひとたび約束されると必ず守られたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: But once he made a promise, he kept it without fail, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Affirming and steady. Voice lifts slightly on "kept it" — pride in his character. Question mark is genuine wonder, not doubt. Reaches to him with "dear."

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんは社内のきまりを大事にされたぞ
lines.en: Gran — your father valued the company's ways deeply, even when he was young.
lines.style: Voice gains weight and solidity here. Respect in every syllable. Pause before "deeply" — it matters. Slight lift at the end, like a quiet nod of recognition.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、お孫様に「だいじょうぶだ」とよく仰ってたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And he'd often tell his grandchildren, "It'll be all right," wouldn't he, dear?
lines.style: Warmth rises here. Her voice softens on the quoted reassurance. Genuine smile audible. Question delivered as intimate confirmation between two people who lived it together.
